meta.title: Implement E-graph based pattern matching for efficient and robust rewriting
meta.body_summary: Introduce e-graph based pattern matching system for ONNX rewriting to reduce pattern explosion and enable order-independent matching, with core data structures, pattern matcher, integration tests, and documentation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot proposed large egraph rewriting engine; CI revealed test failures; maintainer closed due to unclear value without any performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1457 added lines across 7 files, this is a large, all-new feature change that represents a significant architectural extension. Closure due to unclear value is consistent with an unvalidated feature proposal that failed to convince maintainers of its benefit.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer gramalingam closed PR stating 'Value of this is unclear to me. Closing this to reduce clutter in the PR list.' No formal review or inline comments were provided; CI showed 2 test failures in the new integration tests.
review_details.performance_claim: E-graph pattern matching reduces rule explosion, enables order-independent matching without manual commutation, and improves efficiency over traditional tree-based matching.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer explicitly closed citing unclear value and clutter; CI test failures were present but not referenced in closure.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A large, all-new feature proposal that adds significant complexity was rejected because the maintainer found its value unclear; the agent was unable to provide convincing evidence or alignment with project goals, even though it generated well-structured code and documentation.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer read the PR description and decided value was unclear; no substantive code review comments recorded.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Codecov CI reported 2 test failures in egraph integration tests (test_egraph_vs_traditional_commute and test_egraph_integration_with_commutative_patterns), indicating implementation issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes a table of rule reduction but no runtime measurements; no replication steps or profiling data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without addressing CI test failures or maintainer's concerns; no follow-up commits.

core_change_summary.description: Added new modules for egraph-based pattern matching: egraph.py (core E-graph, ENode, EClass, EGraph with hash consing and commutative merging), egraph_pattern.py (EGraphPatternMatcher integrating with RewriteRule), egraph_examples.py, egraph_test.py, egraph_integration_test.py, and documentation. Modified __init__.py to export new symbols.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only __init__.py was modified; all other files are new.
change_trajectory: Commit 8a8df88 added core egraph modules (egraph.py, egraph_pattern.py, egraph_examples.py, egraph_test.py) and updated __init__.py (+1065 lines).
Commit 271661c added documentation (egraph_pattern_matching.md) and integration tests (egraph_integration_test.py) (+392 lines).
Codecov CI reported 2 test failures in integration tests; no further commits.
Maintainer closed PR after ~32 days due to unclear value.

review_signals.summary: Codecov reported 2 failed tests in egraph integration tests, indicating bugs (e.g., 'Expected None, but test returned True').
Maintainer closed PR stating value is unclear and to reduce clutter; open to discussion if value is demonstrated.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot created PR with extensive egraph implementation and documentation.
Codecov bot reported 2 test failures in newly added integration tests.
No human review activity for ~32 days.
Maintainer gramalingam closed the PR citing unclear value and PR list clutter.
